author: Debra Cohen
book_description: The Israeli-Palestinian conflict has taken on a new set of perspectives under the leadership of President Donald Trump in 2025. Learn the pertinent facts about Palestine and see why POTUS47 RELO Plan is the only Two State Solution that works! See how you can help to make living conditions better for both the Israelis and the Gaza Palestinians. A must read for all American citizens and for anyone interested in Middle East Peace.Show more
